themes.title: Electoral Volatility and Internal Friction Facing Right-Wing Parties
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are experiencing significant shifts in their electoral fortunes, alongside internal and external political friction. While the Sweden Democrats face considerable losses in local and national elections, Norway's Fremskrittspartiet sees a dramatic surge in support, positioning itself as a leading force. In the US, the MAGA/Trump movement continues to engage in intense electoral battles and legal challenges related to voting processes.

themes.title: Enduring Influence of Populist Personalities
themes.blurb: Populist personalities continue to be central figures shaping right-wing political narratives and party fortunes. In the US, Donald Trump's past administrative actions, ongoing campaigning, and public image remain a dominant focus, often personifying the broader MAGA movement. Similarly, in Norway, the significant electoral rise of the Progress Party directly elevates the profile and potential leadership of its populist figure, Sylvi Listhaug.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Donald Trump remains a central figure, with coverage focusing on his past administration's policies, current campaigning, and public image, including comparisons to other powerful figures (4, 15, 25, 49).

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: The party's significant rise is linked to the strong personality of its leader, Sylvi Listhaug, and the prospect of her becoming Prime Minister (23, 26).

themes.title: Right-Wing Scrutiny of Social Welfare Policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing movements in different countries are actively engaging with and seeking to redefine the scope and provision of social welfare. The Trump administration's actions regarding public benefits for immigrants, Social Security, and poverty measurement reflect a push to reshape government's role in social support. Concurrently, Marine Le Pen's proposal in France to reform social housing laws indicates a similar re-evaluation of state-mandated social provisions.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: The Trump administration's actions and related legal challenges concerning public benefits for immigrants, potential Social Security cuts, and the measurement of poverty reflect a re-evaluation of welfare provisions (9, 11, 44).

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National

themes.title: Right-Wing Economic Policy Debates
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in multiple nations are actively involved in significant economic policy discussions and proposed reforms. In the United States, the Trump administration's policies concerning Social Security, the redefinition of 'small business,' and the rollback of environmental regulations carry substantial economic implications. Meanwhile, Norway's Progress Party's rise has spurred domestic debates on corporate taxation, wealth tax cuts, and efforts to curb municipal overspending.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Debates and actions around federal economic policies, including potential impacts on Social Security, the redefinition of 'small business,' and regulatory rollbacks concerning power plants and emissions (11, 14, 37, 47).

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Engaged in policy discussions regarding corporate taxation versus wealth tax cuts, and the management of municipal finances to curb overspending (24, 29).
